title: Rename outbox_table.dart and text_download_status.dart to match their table class names
rule: File naming conventions (filename = snake_case of its class)
why: Every other file in this 27-file directory names itself as the exact snake_case of its table class (bookmarks.dart↔Bookmarks, curriculum_tracks.dart↔CurriculumTracks, ...). outbox_table.dart carries a redundant `_table` suffix no sibling has (class is just `Outbox`); text_download_status.dart is singular while its class `TextDownloadStatuses` is plural. Minor but real: `grep -l 'class TextDownloadStatus'` or guessing the file for `Outbox` from the class name fails.
recommendation: Rename outbox_table.dart → outbox.dart and text_download_status.dart → text_download_statuses.dart; update imports.
acceptance_criteria: git grep for the old filenames returns nothing; flutter analyze / build_runner stay green after rename.
